experiment.title: Typed five-term source-orbit quotient locator
experiment.objective: Test whether a source-derived negation-orbit quotient over suffix pair sums lowers the charged locator workload while preserving exact lifted support on two fresh ordinary prime-field curves.

inputs.quotient: x-coordinate of source pair sum R2+R3, with exact member lift

stopping_rules: classify timeout or memory exhaustion as infrastructure evidence
do not omit quotient lift work
invalidation_rules: do not treat a failed sub-full budget as a failed full solver
do not promote toy evidence to an exponent claim
invalidate if source/orbit hashes, lifted witnesses, or direct rho certificates fail
experiment.success_criterion: Both fresh curves have at least one accepted sub-full quotient-class budget with exact projected support, held-out coverage, valid witnesses, full relation rank, and charged total work below the full original-predicate comparator.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Either full control fails, or neither fresh curve has an accepted sub-full budget after quotient construction and member-lift costs are charged.
